title: A Wind Farm in Coal Country

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日新闻通讯《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的Dealbook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月

sentences.en: 18th.
sentences.zh: 18日在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Wind energy, a cornerstone of President Biden's climate agenda, is becoming a popular target for Republican leaders and pundits.
sentences.zh: 风能是拜登总统气候议程的基石，正成为共和党领导人和权威人士的热门攻击目标。

sentences.en: He's not okay with energy.
sentences.zh: 他不喜欢能源。

sentences.en: He wants windmills, the windmills, the windmills that don't work when you need them.
sentences.zh: 他想要风车，那些风车，那些在你需要时却无法工作的风车。

sentences.en: Who mock it as an unreliable eyesore.
sentences.zh: 他们嘲笑风能是不可靠的眼中钉。

sentences.en: People who support wind farms as a rule live very far from wind farMs. That, in their telling, is being forced on the country by out-of-touch liberals.
sentences.zh: 支持风电场的人通常住得离风电场非常远。在他们看来，这是脱离群众的自由派强加给国家的。

sentences.en: How would you like a massive power plant in your backyard?
sentences.zh: 你愿意在自家后院建一座巨大的发电厂吗？

sentences.en: Humming and buzzing and chopping up birds.
sentences.zh: 嗡嗡作响，还会把鸟儿切碎。

sentences.en: That's what a wind turbine is.
sentences.zh: 这就是风力涡轮机。

sentences.en: So why are local conservative lawmakers embracing wind farms?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么当地的保守派议员却在拥抱风电场呢？

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Dion Cerce, traveled to Wyoming to find out.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事迪翁·瑟斯前往怀俄明州一探究竟。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, March 16th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月16日，星期二。

sentences.en: Dion, you recently returned from a reporting trip to Wyoming.
sentences.zh: 迪翁，你最近刚从怀俄明州的采访之旅回来。

sentences.en: Why Wyoming?
sentences.zh: 为什么是怀俄明州？

sentences.en: Well, I knew that Wyoming was one of the reddest states in the nation.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我知道怀俄明州是全美最红的州之一。

sentences.en: People there supported
sentences.zh: 那里的人们

sentences.en: President Trump, you know, overwhelmingly in both elections.
sentences.zh: 在两次选举中都以压倒性优势支持特朗普总统。

sentences.en: This is a state that has powered the nation for generations in coal.
sentences.zh: 这是一个几代人以来一直靠煤炭为国家提供动力的州。

sentences.en: You know, people really latched onto Trump's promise to bring back coal there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那里的人们真的紧紧抓住了特朗普重振煤炭业的承诺。

sentences.en: And I learned that one of the nation's biggest wind farms was being built there.
sentences.zh: 而且我了解到，全国最大的风电场之一正在那里建设。

sentences.en: And so I headed to the home of that wind farm, which is a town called Rollins in a county called Carbon County.
sentences.zh: 所以我前往了那个风电场的所在地，也就是卡本县一个叫罗林斯的城镇。

sentences.en: It's actually called Carbon County.
sentences.zh: 它真的叫卡本县（碳县）。

sentences.en: That's a little on the nose.
sentences.zh: 这名字起得真贴切。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: People say there's so much coal in this part of Wyoming and in Wyoming in general, like you can swing a three iron and you'll be able to mine all of it.
sentences.zh: 人们说怀俄明州的这个地区，乃至整个怀俄明州，煤炭多到你随便挥一下三号铁杆就能挖出全部煤炭。

sentences.en: I mean, that's all it takes.
sentences.zh: 我是说，只需要这样。

sentences.en: And what did you find when you got there?
sentences.zh: 那你到那儿之后发现了什么？

sentences.en: What I found in Rollins was a community that was bustling.
sentences.zh: 我在罗林斯发现了一个熙熙攘攘的社区。

sentences.en: Adventure awaits.
sentences.zh: 冒险在等待。

sentences.en: Embrace the landscape and escape the crowds of Carbon County, Wyoming.
sentences.zh: 拥抱风景，逃离怀俄明州卡本县的人群。

sentences.en: A little town, about 9,000, which is, you know, probably a medium-sized town for Wyoming.
sentences.zh: 一个小镇，大约有9000人，你知道，这对于怀俄明州来说可能算是一个中等规模的城镇。

sentences.en: But, you know, we had a really nice downtown, a coffee shop, a bar, that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 但是，我们有一个非常不错的市中心，有咖啡店、酒吧之类的东西。

sentences.en: People coming and going.
sentences.zh: 人们来来往往。

sentences.en: Get your West on in Wyoming's Carbon County.
sentences.zh: 在怀俄明州的卡本县体验你的西部风情。

sentences.en: And the person who I met with there who showed me around town is a guy called Terry Wycombe.
sentences.zh: 我在那里见到的带我参观城镇的人叫特里·威科姆。

sentences.en: He's the mayor of Rollins and he loves Wyoming.
sentences.zh: 他是罗林斯的市长，他热爱怀俄明州。

sentences.en: It's a great place to do business and to live.
sentences.zh: 这是一个经商和生活的好地方。

sentences.en: It's as good as it gets.
sentences.zh: 好得不能再好了。

sentences.en: The best fishing, the best hunting ever and best place in the world to eat Mexican food.
sentences.zh: 最好的钓鱼、最好的狩猎，还是世界上吃墨西哥菜最好的地方。

sentences.en: Most warm and loving people you've ever been around.
sentences.zh: 你所接触过的最热情、最有爱心的人。

sentences.en: He loves the views.
sentences.zh: 他热爱这里的景色。

sentences.en: He loves the landscapes.
sentences.zh: 他热爱这里的风景。

sentences.en: You know, if you get tired of people, drive over one hill and you won't see anybody for hours.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你厌倦了人，翻过一座山，几个小时内你都看不到任何人。

sentences.en: He should be on the tourism board, the way he talks about it.
sentences.zh: 就他谈论它的方式来看，他应该去旅游局工作。

sentences.en: But not all people would like it here because, you know, the wind blows and the winters are a little bit rough.
sentences.zh: 但并不是所有人都喜欢这里，因为你知道，风很大，冬天也有点难熬。

sentences.en: But most beautiful place in the whole world for summertime.
sentences.zh: 但夏天这里是全世界最美丽的地方。

sentences.en: You just fall in love with the place, you know.
sentences.zh: 你只会爱上这个地方，你知道的。

sentences.en: He loves it.
sentences.zh: 他热爱它。

sentences.en: I mean, a lot of people there are like Terry.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那里很多人都像特里一样。

sentences.en: He really is kind of an embodiment of the zeitgeist of the state.
sentences.zh: 他确实是这个州时代精神的化身。

sentences.en: I moved to Rollins in 1978.
sentences.zh: 我1978年搬到罗林斯。

sentences.en: The oil field was booming as well as the coal mines were going full blaSt.
sentences.zh: 当时油田非常繁荣，煤矿也在全速开采。

sentences.en: It was kind of tough to rent a place and whatnot.
sentences.zh: 租房子什么的有点困难。

sentences.en: But what kept me here was, number one, the opportunity, because I totally believe quality of life begins with a paycheck.
sentences.zh: 但让我留在这里的原因，第一是机会，因为我完全相信生活质量始于工资单。

sentences.en: Did Terry ever work in the coal mines or in the oil industry?
sentences.zh: 特里曾经在煤矿或石油行业工作过吗？

sentences.en: No, he didn't.
sentences.zh: 没有，他没有。

sentences.en: He kind of worked profiting off of those industries.
sentences.zh: 他算是靠这些行业获利。

sentences.en: You know, when there's a boomtown situation going on, I mean, there are jobs for everyone, right, in all kinds of fields.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当出现繁荣城镇的情况时，我是说，每个人都有工作，对吧，在各种领域。

sentences.en: For example, he ended up working in a sign-making business where he would print billboards and signs for coal mines.
sentences.zh: 例如，他最终从事了一份广告牌制作业务，为煤矿印刷广告牌和标志。

sentences.en: That was a lot of his work was, you know, working with the industries but not directly for them.
sentences.zh: 他的大部分工作就是与这些行业合作，而不是直接为他们工作。

sentences.en: So the people in those industries become his clients.
sentences.zh: 所以这些行业的人成了他的客户。

sentences.en: His clients, his customers were coal miners for many years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，他的客户就是煤矿工人。

sentences.en: So like many Americans who live in coal country or oil country, those industries are vital to him and to his sense of himself and the community.
sentences.zh: 所以像许多生活在煤炭之乡或石油之乡的美国人一样，这些行业对他以及他对自我和社区的认同感至关重要。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: I mean, really, people have a lot of their identity in Wyoming wrapped up in coal.
sentences.zh: 我是说，真的，怀俄明州人们的很多身份认同都与煤炭紧密相连。

sentences.en: When I first moved here, it was like coal will never go away.
sentences.zh: 我刚搬到这里时，感觉煤炭永远不会消失。

sentences.en: We've got a lot of it.
sentences.zh: 我们有很多煤炭。

sentences.en: It's just a lot of pride and power in the United States with energy.
sentences.zh: 这在美国能源方面是一种极大的自豪感和力量。

sentences.en: This is the industry that put food on the table, that put their kids through college, and they're proud of it.
sentences.zh: 这是养家糊口、供孩子上大学的行业，他们为此感到自豪。

sentences.en: And how would you describe Terry's politics, his worldview?
sentences.zh: 你会如何描述特里的政治立场和世界观？

sentences.en: Terry is conservative.
sentences.zh: 特里是保守派。

sentences.en: He voted for Trump in both elections.
sentences.zh: 他在两次选举中都投票给了特朗普。

sentences.en: And he is a huge supporter of the industry that made Wyoming what it is, and that is fossil fuels.
sentences.zh: 他是造就了怀俄明州的那个行业的坚定支持者，那就是化石燃料。

sentences.en: I'm not a true believer in, when you say climate change, Al Gore's face comes into my vision.
sentences.zh: 我不是那种真正的信徒，当你提到气候变化时，阿尔·戈尔的脸就会浮现在我的脑海里。

sentences.en: I'm not a radical climate change believer, okay?
sentences.zh: 我不是激进的气候变化信徒，好吗？

sentences.en: I'm just not.
sentences.zh: 我只是不是。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: You'd have to talk a long time to convince me that I should take a different viewpoint.
sentences.zh: 你得花很长时间才能说服我接受不同的观点。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: He just doesn't buy it.
sentences.zh: 他就是不买账。

sentences.en: So I wonder what happens to people like Terry and to this community when inevitably, as we all know, these local industries, especially coal, starts to enter a period of decline.
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，当这些地方产业，尤其是煤炭，不可避免地开始进入衰退期时，像特里这样的人和这个社区会发生什么。

sentences.en: Well, when that happened in Carbon County in the 80s, when mines started closing down, it was devastating.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当80年代卡本县发生这种情况，矿山开始关闭时，那是毁灭性的。

sentences.en: People's identities were suddenly pulled out from under them.
sentences.zh: 人们的身份认同突然被连根拔起。

sentences.en: The town of Rollins used to be twice as big as it is now.
sentences.zh: 罗林斯镇曾经的规模是现在的两倍。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, half the town moved away.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你知道，半个城镇的人都搬走了。

sentences.en: There just were no jobs.
sentences.zh: 那里根本没有工作。

sentences.en: And it wasn't just the coal miners.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是煤矿工人。

sentences.en: People like Terry saw his business decline.
sentences.zh: 像特里这样的人眼看着他的生意下滑。

sentences.en: All the industries that profited off of the coal mining situation there were all just cratered.
sentences.zh: 所有从当地煤矿开采情况中获利的行业都崩溃了。

sentences.en: It was really hard for everyone.
sentences.zh: 这对每个人来说都非常艰难。

sentences.en: You know, when they close the coal mine, that's like one day you go to work and you're making, you know, exceptionally good money for the area.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当他们关闭煤矿时，就像有一天你去上班，你赚的钱对于该地区来说非常可观。

sentences.en: And then the next day you go and you don't have a job.
sentences.zh: 然后第二天你去上班，却失业了。

sentences.en: A lot of houses got repossessed.
sentences.zh: 很多房子被收回了。

sentences.en: Several service stations closed.
sentences.zh: 几家服务站关闭了。

sentences.en: And then several restaurants closed.
sentences.zh: 然后几家餐馆也关闭了。

sentences.en: It sounds pretty devastating.
sentences.zh: 听起来非常具有破坏性。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: I mean, can you imagine one day just, hey, there's no place to work.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你能想象有一天突然发现，嘿，没地方工作了吗？

sentences.en: It all happened within about a year, year and a half.
sentences.zh: 这一切都发生在大约一年到一年半的时间里。

sentences.en: And it was pretty sudden, if you will, you know.
sentences.zh: 而且非常突然，如果你愿意这么说的话。

sentences.en: All of us lost a little bit when they closed those coal mines.
sentences.zh: 当他们关闭那些煤矿时，我们每个人都失去了一点东西。

sentences.en: Everyone had to make this dramatic shift to figure out what they were going to do next.
sentences.zh: 每个人都必须做出这种剧烈的转变，去弄清楚接下来该做什么。

sentences.en: How were they going to survive?
sentences.zh: 他们该如何生存？

sentences.en: How was the town and how was Carbon County going to survive?
sentences.zh: 城镇和卡本县该如何生存？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But of course, Terry Wycombe doesn't work in that industry.
sentences.zh: 但当然，特里·威科姆并不在那个行业工作。

sentences.en: So what ends up happening to him?
sentences.zh: 那么他最终怎么样了？

sentences.en: Well, he saw Carbon County, you know, really, really struggling to figure out what was next for it and what was going to become of it with all these mines closing down.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他看到卡本县真的在努力弄清楚接下来该做什么，以及随着所有这些矿山的关闭，它会变成什么样。

sentences.en: He was a business guy.
sentences.zh: 他是个生意人。

sentences.en: He had a lot of experience and a lot of jobs.
sentences.zh: 他有很多经验和很多工作经历。

sentences.en: And he decided that he could put that business acumen to use.
sentences.zh: 他决定可以利用这种商业头脑。

sentences.en: And he decided to run for county commissioner.
sentences.zh: 他决定竞选县政委员。

sentences.en: You know, the fact of the matter is there was a lot of people walking around on their bottom lip.
sentences.zh: 你知道，事实是，当时很多人都垂头丧气。

sentences.en: You know, the government is not good at running businesses.
sentences.zh: 你知道，政府不擅长经营企业。

sentences.en: And the government, whether it be city or county or whatever, is a lot of times not good at anything about business.
sentences.zh: 而且政府，无论是市级还是县级，很多时候在商业方面什么都不擅长。

sentences.en: And so I felt that me being a businessman, I would bring a new perspective.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为作为一个商人，我会带来新的视角。

sentences.en: He knows that he is there as a representative of the business community.
sentences.zh: 他知道他是作为商业界的代表在那里。

sentences.en: And he can maybe start to make some decisions that will keep Carbon County on the map.
sentences.zh: 他或许可以开始做出一些决定，让卡本县继续留在地图上。

sentences.en: And what are those decisions?
sentences.zh: 那些决定是什么？

sentences.en: What kind of options does Carbon County and this commission really have at this point?
sentences.zh: 在这一点上，卡本县和这个委员会到底有什么选择？

sentences.en: Well, around the late 2000s, developers start approaching Terry and coming before the commission with ideas about building giant wind farMs.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在2000年代末左右，开发商开始接触特里，并带着建造巨型风电场的想法来到委员会面前。

sentences.en: With wind, it was kind of a gold rush, if you will.
sentences.zh: 对于风能，这就像是一场淘金热，如果你愿意这么说的话。

sentences.en: And everybody and anybody wanted to get in the wind business.
sentences.zh: 每个人都想进入风能行业。

sentences.en: I think at first he was pretty intrigued.
sentences.zh: 我想起初他很感兴趣。

sentences.en: A decent amount of money in tax revenue that the county could get.
sentences.zh: 县里可以获得相当可观的税收收入。

sentences.en: But then all of a sudden, tons of companies start coming before the board.
sentences.zh: 但突然之间，大量的公司开始出现在董事会面前。

sentences.en: One particular company was so abrasive.
sentences.zh: 其中一家公司特别咄咄逼人。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Just try to bully you into it.
sentences.zh: 简直是试图强迫你接受。

sentences.en: And it was like, well, you're going to get all this money.
sentences.zh: 就像是，你会得到所有这些钱。

sentences.en: Yeah, but I'm giving up my entire way of life.
sentences.zh: 是的，但我放弃了我的整个生活方式。

sentences.en: You know, just stuff like that used to just drive me crazy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这种事情过去常常让我抓狂。

sentences.en: And then opposition started.
sentences.zh: 然后反对声就开始了。

sentences.en: What started out as sounding like a cool way to make some cash for the county.
sentences.zh: 起初听起来像是为县里赚点钱的好方法。

sentences.en: They suddenly seem like, huh, maybe we better slow down and think about this.
sentences.zh: 他们突然觉得，嗯，也许我们最好慢下来考虑一下。

sentences.en: There are certain places you don't want wind farMs.
sentences.zh: 有些地方你是不想建风电场的。

sentences.en: For instance, let's say that it's out where it's all public land.
sentences.zh: 例如，假设它是在全是公共土地的地方。

sentences.en: And then you permit a wind farm there.
sentences.zh: 然后你就在那里批准了一个风电场。

sentences.en: Then all of a sudden, you can't hunt there.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，你就不能在那里打猎了。

sentences.en: Because hunting and whatnot is a way of life out here.
sentences.zh: 因为打猎之类的活动是我们这里的一种生活方式。

sentences.en: It's something almost everybody does.
sentences.zh: 几乎每个人都会这么做。

sentences.en: And their favorite Vista, too, right?
sentences.zh: 还有他们最喜欢的远景，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's what some people come to Wyoming to see.
sentences.zh: 这就是有些人来怀俄明州想看的东西。

sentences.en: And we had to reserve certain places like that just because it made common sense.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不保留某些像那样的地方，仅仅是因为这符合常识。

sentences.en: He kind of realized that he had a situation here and a huge decision to make for the county.
sentences.zh: 他意识到自己面临着一种局面，而且要为县里做出一个巨大的决定。

sentences.en: And so what does Terry do?
sentences.zh: 那么特里是怎么做的呢？

sentences.en: So Terry puts a halt on things.
sentences.zh: 特里叫停了这些项目。

sentences.en: He starts talking to people.
sentences.zh: 他开始与人们交谈。

sentences.en: He goes all over the state.
sentences.zh: 他跑遍了整个州。

sentences.en: He talks to other county officials.
sentences.zh: 他与县里的其他官员交谈。

sentences.en: He goes to the state capitol.
sentences.zh: 他去了州议会大厦。

sentences.en: He talks to lawmakers.
sentences.zh: 他与立法者交谈。

sentences.en: He talks to wind developers.
sentences.zh: 他与风能开发商交谈。

sentences.en: He talks to people like everyone around town.
sentences.zh: 他与镇上的每个人交谈。

sentences.en: He tries to figure out what people are thinking and what the developers themselves are pitching.
sentences.zh: 他试图弄清楚人们在想什么，以及开发商自己正在推销什么。

sentences.en: What are the long-term consequences?
sentences.zh: 长期后果是什么？

sentences.en: What are the short-term consequences?
sentences.zh: 短期后果是什么？

sentences.en: Just how many jobs are these things going to produce?
sentences.zh: 这些东西到底能创造多少就业机会？

sentences.en: Are they going to be a blight on the landscape?
sentences.zh: 它们会破坏景观吗？

sentences.en: He just basically looks around and weighs everything that he's learned.
sentences.zh: 他基本上只是环顾四周，权衡他所了解到的一切。

sentences.en: And he decides it's in the best interest of the county to start approving some of these things.
sentences.zh: 他决定，批准其中一些项目符合县里的最大利益。

sentences.en: And he does just that.
sentences.zh: 于是他真的这么做了。

sentences.en: I mean, he allows some of the wind farms to start to break ground.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他允许一些风电场开始动工。

sentences.en: He is seeing the bigger picture here.
sentences.zh: 他看到了这里的大局。

sentences.en: And that bigger picture is what in his mind?
sentences.zh: 那么在他心目中，这个大局是什么呢？

sentences.en: So for Terry, the bigger picture comes down to dollar signs.
sentences.zh: 对特里来说，大局归根结底就是金钱。

sentences.en: It has nothing to do with ideology.
sentences.zh: 这与意识形态无关。

sentences.en: It doesn't have anything to do with fossil fuels, emissions, pollution, climate change.
sentences.zh: 这与化石燃料、排放、污染、气候变化毫无关系。

sentences.en: It's all about the bottom line.
sentences.zh: 一切都关乎底线。

sentences.en: He wants to help Carbon County survive and head into the future in a good place.
sentences.zh: 他想帮助卡本县生存下去，并以良好的状态迈向未来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Dionne, how does Carbon County start to change once Terry and the commission approve these wind projects?
sentences.zh: 那么，迪翁，一旦特里和委员会批准了这些风能项目，卡本县开始发生怎样的变化？

sentences.en: So, it's a real change for Carbon County and for Rollins itself.
sentences.zh: 这对卡本县和罗林斯本身来说，都是真正的改变。

sentences.en: You know, workers are coming in.
sentences.zh: 你知道，工人们进来了。

sentences.en: They're spending money at hotels.
sentences.zh: 他们在酒店消费。

sentences.en: They're spending money at the local bar, the Rifleman's Club.
sentences.zh: 他们在当地的酒吧，也就是步枪手俱乐部消费。

sentences.en: They start seeing, you know, even amid all the decline of fossil fuels, they start seeing real revenue come into their coffers.
sentences.zh: 他们开始看到，你知道，即使在化石燃料衰退的情况下，他们也开始看到真正的收入进入了他们的金库。

sentences.en: From, you know, sales tax and, you know, the other fees that the wind projects have to spend.
sentences.zh: 来自，你知道，销售税，以及，你知道，风能项目必须支付的其他费用。

sentences.en: And a new rec center goes up.
sentences.zh: 一个新的娱乐中心建起来了。

sentences.en: You know, improvements are made to the school.
sentences.zh: 你知道，学校得到了改善。

sentences.en: You know, things are happening in the town.
sentences.zh: 你知道，镇上正在发生变化。

sentences.en: And there's a real difference that's felt.
sentences.zh: 人们感受到了真正的不同。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So, this is doing precisely the thing that Terry Wycombe and his fellow county commissioners had hoped it would do.
sentences.zh: 所以，这正是特里·威科姆和他的县政委员同事们所希望达到的效果。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: But the problem is, is it's not coal.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，它不是煤炭。

sentences.en: There aren't as many jobs in the end.
sentences.zh: 最终并没有那么多工作岗位。

sentences.en: One wind farm that I toured when I was in Wyoming, it took 300 workers to build some, like, 50-some turbines.
sentences.zh: 我在怀俄明州参观过一个风电场，建造50多台涡轮机需要300名工人。

sentences.en: And once it's up and operational, it'll only take 10 workers to operate.
sentences.zh: 一旦建成并投入运营，只需要10名工人来操作。

sentences.en: And that's for, you know, the next 20, 30 years, the life of, you know, the wind farm.
sentences.zh: 而且那是为了，你知道，未来20到30年，也就是风电场的寿命期。

sentences.en: And that's a huge, huge decrease from, you know, a coal mine, right?
sentences.zh: 与煤矿相比，这减少了非常非常多，对吧？

sentences.en: Which takes workers constantly, you know, in and out.
sentences.zh: 煤矿需要工人不断地进进出出。

sentences.en: And so it's different.
sentences.zh: 所以情况不同。

sentences.en: But as Terry likes to say, it's something, and something is better than nothing.
sentences.zh: 但正如特里喜欢说的，总比没有好，有总比无强。

sentences.en: Like, at least these jobs, you know, this handful of jobs will exiSt.
sentences.zh: 至少这些工作，你知道，这少数几个工作岗位将会存在。

sentences.en: So as these wind farms start popping up, delivering jobs, not as many jobs as coal, but jobs, what is the reaction to them from the community over time?
sentences.zh: 那么随着这些风电场开始涌现，提供就业机会——虽然不如煤炭多，但确实提供了就业——社区随着时间的推移对它们有什么反应？

sentences.en: How does Terry characterize that?
sentences.zh: 特里是如何描述这种反应的？

sentences.en: Well, the reaction is pretty mixed.
sentences.zh: 嗯，反应相当复杂。

sentences.en: You know, some people like how they look.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有些人喜欢它们的样子。

sentences.en: Some people think the wind turbines are pretty.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为风力涡轮机很漂亮。

sentences.en: What went through your mind the first time you saw the wind turbines propped up on the land?
sentences.zh: 你第一次看到土地上竖起风力涡轮机时，心里是怎么想的？

sentences.en: I loved them.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢它们。

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 真的。

sentences.en: They were mesmerizing to me.
sentences.zh: 它们让我着迷。

sentences.en: But, you know, one of Terry's friends told him that he can't even look at them when he drives by them.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，特里的一个朋友告诉他，他开车经过时甚至不敢看它们。

sentences.en: He just averts his eyes.
sentences.zh: 他只是把目光移开。

sentences.en: One of the guys I work with today, I was telling him what I was doing today.
sentences.zh: 今天和我一起工作的一个人，我告诉他我今天在做什么。

sentences.en: And his first thing out of his mouth was, I hate looking at them.
sentences.zh: 他脱口而出的第一句话就是，我讨厌看它们。

sentences.en: Well, look the other direction.
sentences.zh: 好吧，往另一个方向看。

sentences.en: I don't know what to tell you.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该跟你说什么。

sentences.en: I don't.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: There are certain cars that some manufacturers make.
sentences.zh: 有些制造商生产的某些汽车。

sentences.en: I hate looking at them, too.
sentences.zh: 我也讨厌看它们。

sentences.en: But they're allowed.
sentences.zh: 但它们是被允许存在的。

sentences.en: And that resistance to these farms eventually cost Terry.
sentences.zh: 而对这些风电场的抵制最终让特里付出了代价。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, and what happened when you ran for re-election to the commissioner's office the last time?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你上次竞选连任县政委员时发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, I won two times in a row.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我连续赢了两次。

sentences.en: And the last time I lost my 24 votes.
sentences.zh: 而最后一次我以24票之差输了。

sentences.en: When Terry ran for re-election to the county commission in 2014, he lost his seat.
sentences.zh: 2014年特里竞选连任县政委员时，他失去了席位。

sentences.en: And he blames Wind.
sentences.zh: 他把这归咎于风能。

sentences.en: Well, Dionne, you were there and you talked to lots of residents in the community.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迪翁，你在现场，你和社区里的许多居民谈过。

sentences.en: I assume many who opposed Wind.
sentences.zh: 我想其中许多人反对风能。

sentences.en: How do you explain what they were thinking and perhaps why he lost?
sentences.zh: 你如何解释他们的想法，以及他为什么会落选？

sentences.en: I think they just don't like how it looks.
sentences.zh: 我想他们只是不喜欢它们的样子。

sentences.en: I really do think that's part of it.
sentences.zh: 我真的认为这是原因之一。

sentences.en: I think it's, you know, they love, they all talk about wide open spaces.
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道，他们热爱，他们都在谈论广阔的开放空间。

sentences.en: You know, I do this thing sometimes when I go into rural communities.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我有时去农村社区时会做这件事。

sentences.en: I walk around a cemetery.
sentences.zh: 我会在墓地走走。

sentences.en: And like the local town cemetery, I really feel like you get kind of a vibe for the town in these graveyards.
sentences.zh: 就像当地的镇墓地，我真的觉得你在这些墓地里能感受到这个小镇的氛围。

sentences.en: And I noticed on, you know, a number of gravestones, there were empty landscapes like mountains and trees and whatever etched onto the headstones themselves.
sentences.zh: 我注意到，你知道，许多墓碑上刻着空旷的景观，比如山脉、树木等等。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's how much people love their empty vistas.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，人们是多么热爱他们空旷的远景。

sentences.en: They want to be buried for eternity, you know, underneath that.
sentences.zh: 他们想在永恒中被埋葬在那种景色之下。

sentences.en: And I thought that was, you know, that's real.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那是，你知道，那是真实的。

sentences.en: But also, you know, there's this identity thing going on there.
sentences.zh: 但同时，你知道，那里存在着一种身份认同感。

sentences.en: What do you think was behind that frustration with Wind, even if it was just, you know, those 24 votes?
sentences.zh: 你认为这种对风能的挫败感背后是什么，即使仅仅是那24票？

sentences.en: Well, I think it's because they're more,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为是因为它们更多，

sentences.en: because it's new and it's scary.
sentences.zh: 因为它是新的，而且令人害怕。

sentences.en: You know, when you have 80% of the people that live in our county working in the extraction business, of course, they're going to not want to help, you know, feed a competitor.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你县里80%的人都在从事采掘业时，他们当然不想帮助，你知道，去喂养一个竞争对手。

sentences.en: People love coal and they see coal and wind in competition.
sentences.zh: 人们热爱煤炭，他们把煤炭和风能视为竞争关系。

sentences.en: And, you know, this is a place that grew up with coal and they don't like it.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这是一个伴随着煤炭成长起来的地方，他们不喜欢这样。

sentences.en: They look at it as a, you know, I don't look at it as competition.
sentences.zh: 他们看待它，你知道，我不把它看作竞争。

sentences.en: I don't have a choice of wind or coal.
sentences.zh: 我没有风能或煤炭的选择。

sentences.en: I turn on my electricity, it comes on or it don't.
sentences.zh: 我打开电源，它要么有电，要么没电。

sentences.en: But a lot of people think or feel that coal is
sentences.zh: 但很多人认为或觉得煤炭

sentences.en: being beat up or limited by other sources.
sentences.zh: 正受到其他能源的打击或限制。

sentences.en: So in this way of thinking, not only is wind an eyesore, it is quite literally undermining the industry essential to so many people's identity there.
sentences.zh: 所以按照这种思维方式，风能不仅碍眼，而且实际上正在破坏那里许多人身份认同所必需的产业。

sentences.en: Wind is literally hurting coal and oil competitively.
sentences.zh: 风能确实在竞争上伤害了煤炭和石油。

sentences.en: And it sounds like the environmental benefit of wind as an alternative, that it's cleaner, that it's far cleaner as a source of energy, is not persuasive to those skeptics.
sentences.zh: 听起来，风能作为替代能源的环境效益，即它更清洁，作为能源来源远为清洁，对那些怀疑论者来说并没有说服力。

sentences.en: That's how a lot of people feel.
sentences.zh: 很多人都是这么想的。

sentences.en: Not everyone, but, you know, instead of, you know, workers climbing down into the mines, now they're climbing up into wind turbines and not as many of them.
sentences.zh: 不是每个人，但是，你知道，工人们不再是爬进矿井，现在他们是爬进风力涡轮机，而且人数没那么多。

sentences.en: And, you know, they just feel like this is a direct affront to their way of life.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们只是觉得这是对他们生活方式的直接冒犯。

sentences.en: You know, you can get rid of wind energy in Carbon County if you want,
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你愿意，你可以摆脱卡本县的风能，

sentences.en: but then we won't have coal, we won't, we'll have a limited amount of oil and gas, and we won't have wind.
sentences.zh: 但那样我们就没有煤炭了，我们，我们将只有有限的石油和天然气，而且我们也不会有风能。

sentences.en: It isn't going to bring back coal and oil and gas.
sentences.zh: 这并不会带回煤炭、石油和天然气。

sentences.en: As far as, like, people here wanting them because they're great energy,
sentences.zh: 至于这里的人们因为它们是伟大的能源而想要它们，

sentences.en: very few percent of the people thought that way about it.
sentences.zh: 只有极少数人是这样想的。

sentences.en: So, Terry has lost his seat as county commissioner, in large part, he thinks, because of these growing wind projects.
sentences.zh: 所以，特里失去了县政委员的席位，他认为很大程度上是因为这些不断增长的风能项目。

sentences.en: Where does that leave wind initiatives after 2014?
sentences.zh: 2014年之后，风能倡议处于什么位置？

sentences.en: Does it discourage more development?
sentences.zh: 这会阻碍更多的开发吗？

sentences.en: Is it seen as a setback for wind?
sentences.zh: 这被视为风能的挫折吗？

sentences.en: I don't really think so.
sentences.zh: 我真的不这么认为。

sentences.en: I mean, other wind projects are still coming online and are still, you know, getting approved.
sentences.zh: 我是说，其他风能项目仍在上线，并且仍在，你知道，获得批准。

sentences.en: And, in fact, the very reason that I came to Carbon County is this big, giant wind farm right south of town that Terry helped usher in.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我来到卡本县的真正原因，就是镇南边那个特里协助引进的大型风电场。

sentences.en: And it's going to be humongous.
sentences.zh: 它将会非常巨大。

sentences.en: You know, construction is still going on and will be going on for a few more years.
sentences.zh: 你知道，建设仍在进行中，并将持续几年。

sentences.en: But, you know, there's something like a thousand turbines, and it's big enough to power a city of a million.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，大约有一千台涡轮机，它大到足以为一个百万人口的城市供电。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's just, it's going to be really, really massive and sprawling.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，它只是，它将会非常、非常巨大且蔓延。

sentences.en: And that's Terry's legacy.
sentences.zh: 这就是特里的遗产。

sentences.en: So, I'm curious, can you tell me a little bit about the chokecherry plant?
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，你能跟我讲讲苦樱桃工厂吗？

sentences.en: Because Carbon County is likely to be known now as home of the biggest wind farm in the United States, instead of coal country.
sentences.zh: 因为卡本县现在很可能被称为美国最大风电场的所在地，而不是煤炭之乡。

sentences.en: It might be wind country now.
sentences.zh: 现在它可能是风能之乡了。

sentences.en: How do you feel about that?
sentences.zh: 你对此感觉如何？

sentences.en: Oh, I feel like a champion.
sentences.zh: 哦，我觉得自己像个冠军。

sentences.en: I help make it happen.
sentences.zh: 我帮助实现了它。

sentences.en: You know, they could go anywhere and do whatever they're going to do.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们可以去任何地方做他们想做的事。

sentences.en: But they, you know, they chose here.
sentences.zh: 但他们，你知道，他们选择了这里。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's one of those things where we probably could have worked our tail off and got rid of them.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这属于那种我们本可以拼命工作把它们赶走的情况。

sentences.en: But, man, am I glad we didn't.
sentences.zh: 但老兄，我真庆幸我们没那么做。

sentences.en: They're creating jobs.
sentences.zh: 他们正在创造就业机会。

sentences.en: They're spending money downtown.
sentences.zh: 他们正在市中心消费。

sentences.en: It's just going to get better and better and better.
sentences.zh: 一切只会越来越好。

sentences.en: Dan, how should we be thinking about Terry Wycombe in this very important and interesting moment in the United States debate over, really, the future of energy?
sentences.zh: 丹，在美国关于能源未来的辩论中，在这个非常重要且有趣的时刻，我们该如何看待特里·威科姆？

sentences.en: He pushes through these wind projects, but not because he believes they are an important part of fighting climate change.
sentences.zh: 他推动了这些风能项目，但并不是因为他相信这是应对气候变化的重要一环。

sentences.en: On the contrary, he doesn't believe in climate change.
sentences.zh: 恰恰相反，他不相信气候变化。

sentences.en: He sees them purely through an economic lens.
sentences.zh: 他纯粹是从经济角度来看待这些项目。

sentences.en: And yet he suffers politically for having done that and on those terMs.
sentences.zh: 然而，他却因为这样做以及基于这些条件而承受了政治压力。

sentences.en: Well, I think America is filled with climate skeptics like Terry Wycombe's.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为美国到处都是像特里·威科姆那样的气候怀疑论者。

sentences.en: I mean, guys who aren't going to do this kind of work bringing in green energy because, you know, they have some big sense of ideology.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那些不会因为某种宏大的意识形态而去做引进绿色能源这种工作的人。

sentences.en: I think, you know, a lot of a lot of politicians in the country are practical, especially at the local level.
sentences.zh: 我认为，你知道，这个国家的很多政客都很务实，尤其是在地方层面。

sentences.en: And that's where this change is going to happen.
sentences.zh: 而这种改变正是在那里发生的。

sentences.en: You know, the new president, Joe Biden, and the Democratic Congress and, you know, those folks can do a lot for climate.
sentences.zh: 你知道，新总统乔·拜登和民主党控制的国会，那些人确实能为气候做很多事。

sentences.en: There's the Paris Accord.
sentences.zh: 有《巴黎协定》。

sentences.en: There's, you know, all kinds of high minded, big picture climate actions that they can take.
sentences.zh: 还有各种高瞻远瞩、宏观层面的气候行动可以采取。

sentences.en: But it's going to come down to communities like Rollins, to city councils, to county commissions, to people like Terry Wycombe, who are going to make these decisions, you know,
sentences.zh: 但最终还是要靠像罗林斯这样的社区，靠市议会，靠县委员会，靠特里·威科姆这样的人来做决定，你知道，

sentences.en: in the best interests of the residents in their own towns and cities.
sentences.zh: 为了他们城镇居民的最大利益。

sentences.en: I feel like that's why we hear the new president talking about renewable energy in economic terMs.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这就是为什么我们听到新总统用经济术语谈论可再生能源的原因。

sentences.en: He always talks about these projects as job creators.
sentences.zh: 他总是把这些项目称为就业创造者。

sentences.en: He does not talk about it purely as a question of climate and the environment.
sentences.zh: 他谈论这些时，并不纯粹将其视为气候和环境问题。

sentences.en: He kind of talks about it the way Terry Wycombe does.
sentences.zh: 他谈论的方式有点像特里·威科姆。

sentences.en: And I feel like that's not an accident.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这并非偶然。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想你是对的。

sentences.en: I think that Carbon County is a case study for the entire nation when it comes to renewable energy and how we should look at wind and solar and selling, you know,
sentences.zh: 我认为卡本县是全国在可再生能源方面的一个案例研究，关于我们应该如何看待风能和太阳能，以及如何推销，你知道，

sentences.en: this move away from fossil fuels.
sentences.zh: 这种摆脱化石燃料的举措。

sentences.en: And that became particularly clear, you know, in the recent past, because last year, you know, all the counties in Wyoming were in the red.
sentences.zh: 这一点在最近变得尤为清晰，因为去年，你知道，怀俄明州所有的县都陷入了财政赤字。

sentences.en: All their budgets were just facing these huge, huge deficits.
sentences.zh: 他们所有的预算都面临着巨大的赤字。

sentences.en: But Carbon County is one of three counties, all of which have wind projects going on to end the year 2020, the most awful of years, you know, in the black.
sentences.zh: 但卡本县是三个县之一，它们都有风能项目在进行，最终在2020年这个最糟糕的年份实现了盈利。

sentences.en: They have budget surpluses.
sentences.zh: 他们有预算盈余。

sentences.en: And Terry really knows that that's his work.
sentences.zh: 特里真的很清楚那是他的功劳。

sentences.en: It all came from wind, and he's really proud of that.
sentences.zh: 这一切都来自风能，他对此感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: And when you are driving along and look out at these wind turbines or see them spinning in the distance now, what goes through your mind?
sentences.zh: 当你开车经过，看着这些风力涡轮机，或者看着它们在远处旋转时，你脑子里在想什么？

sentences.en: Cha-ching.
sentences.zh: 叮当响。

sentences.en: Money.
sentences.zh: 钱。

sentences.en: It's not going to be an easy sell in a lot of communities.
sentences.zh: 在很多社区，这并不容易推销。

sentences.en: It's just not.
sentences.zh: 确实不容易。

sentences.en: And so I think, you know, in order to make the future more green, I think that we're just going to have to figure out what works for different communities.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，为了让未来更绿色，我们必须找到适合不同社区的方法。

sentences.en: And what the best approach is.
sentences.zh: 以及什么是最好的方案。

sentences.en: It feels like you have an opportunity to really remake yourself as a community here.
sentences.zh: 感觉你们在这里有一个真正重塑社区的机会。

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对是。

sentences.en: We're in the biggest transformation ever.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于有史以来最大的转型中。

sentences.en: When in the world could you ever, from the ground up, do this?
sentences.zh: 在这个世界上，你什么时候能从零开始做这件事？

sentences.en: It's like one of the girls that works at the courthouse.
sentences.zh: 就像在法院工作的一位女孩。

sentences.en: One day, she just looked at me with this look on her face.
sentences.zh: 有一天，她看着我，眼神里流露出一种神情。

sentences.en: I wish I could duplicate.
sentences.zh: 我真希望我能复制那种神情。

sentences.en: And she said, you do realize this is a one-in-a-lifetime opportunity to make Rollins bigger and better.
sentences.zh: 她说，你意识到这是一个千载难逢的机会，可以让罗林斯变得更大、更好。

sentences.en: And I'm just so fortunate to have the timing of being the mayor at this time.
sentences.zh: 我非常幸运，能在此时担任市长。

sentences.en: You know, it's exciting to me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这让我感到兴奋。

sentences.en: Well, Dionne, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，迪翁，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Terry, thank you so much for spending so much time with us and using up your lunch break to talk to us.
sentences.zh: 特里，非常感谢你花这么多时间陪我们，还牺牲了午休时间来和我们交谈。

sentences.en: I really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激。

sentences.en: Well, I appreciate you drawing attention to my town.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我很感谢你们关注我的城镇。

sentences.en: Can you send people out here and let me show them around?
sentences.zh: 你能派人过来，让我带他们四处看看吗？

sentences.en: I will.
sentences.zh: 我会的。

sentences.en: Because if they come out here and they spend any amount of time, they're going to want to move here.
sentences.zh: 因为如果他们来到这里，待上一段时间，他们就会想搬到这里来。

sentences.en: Our air is clean and we're good people.
sentences.zh: 我们的空气很干净，我们也是好人。

sentences.en: On Monday afternoon, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周一下午，美国参议院以微弱优势确认了拜登总统提名的内政部长人选，也是其气候议程的关键人物，来自新墨西哥州的众议员德布·哈兰德，

sentences.en: Senate narrowly confirmed President Biden's nominee for Secretary of the Interior and a key player in his climate agenda, Congresswoman Deb Haaland of New Mexico,
sentences.zh: 她是第一位管理内阁机构的美国原住民。

sentences.en: the first Native American to run a cabinet agency.
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，预计哈兰德将迅速扩大可再生能源的开发，包括她在家乡州一再推动的风能。

sentences.en: The Times reports that Haaland is expected to rapidly expand the development of renewable energy, including wind, which she has repeatedly pushed for in her home state.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Infections are spiking in several European countries, where vaccines are in short supply and have been rolled out at a sluggish pace.
sentences.zh: 在意大利，过去两周内新增病例增加了34%。

sentences.en: In Italy, new cases are up 34% over the past two weeks.
